title: lifecycle.v1
description: The bot's DOMAIN status (distinct from runtime.v1's container lifecycle). The bot emits these to its control-plane callback; the legal transitions are the state machine in the README.

DisclosureOutcome.description: How the bot told the meeting it is recording: `chat` when the invocation's disclosure was posted in meeting chat (posted_at = when the sent message was seen), `bot_name_only` when it could not be posted and only the bot's display name carries the notice (detail = why).

LifecycleEvent.description: One status report. connection_id + status always present; the rest are state-dependent (forensics on terminal states). LIBERAL ingestion (additionalProperties:true): the control plane validates the core shape but TOLERATES extra fields the real bot emits, matching main's pydantic ignore-extras — the carve's earlier additionalProperties:false rejected the bot's real callbacks.

bot_logs.description: terminal: ring buffer of log lines

timestamp.description: ISO8601 emit time — the real bot sends it on every callback

error_details.description: terminal: free-text error context from the bot

disclosure.description: post-admission: the outcome of the chat disclosure, reported once on an `active` event; persisted at meeting.data.disclosure (first report wins)
